Job Title: Accounts & Taxation Executive

Location: Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune (In-office)

About Registration Arena

Registration Arena is India’s leading online professional services platform for business registration, IPRs, accounting, auditing and taxation backed by a team of over 20+ top-notch professionals based in Pune, India. With over 10 years of experience, we are dedicated to simplifying entrepreneurship by helping individuals and businesses start, manage, and grow with ease and affordability. Our services include incorporation of companies and LLPs, ROC filings, intellectual property rights and trademark registrations, bookkeeping, auditing, taxation, and company law compliances, statutory audits and tax audits etc. Leveraging technology, we provide accurate, transparent, and cost-effective solutions by connecting entrepreneurs with our trusted professionals such as Chartered Accountants and Company Secretaries.

Why Join Us? – What’s in It for You
• Time Off: Last Saturdays off every month.
• Work Environment: Informal dress code and a positive, growth-driven atmosphere.
• Training and Development: Regular In-house Training Sessions: Focused related areas Fast-paced Learning Curve and Mentorship
• Recognition: Certificate of employment and Letter of Recommendation upon successful tenure.
• Team Culture: Collaborative and supportive work environment that values creativity, innovation, and mutual respect.
• Leadership: Approachable management with open communication.
• Celebrations: Team events for milestones, birthdays, and achievements.
• Friendly and Professional Work Environment: Supportive seniors, open culture, and collaborative team
• Professional Growth: Hands-on exposure to Accounting, Auditing, and Taxation work across diverse industries.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Senior Accountant in our CA Team, you will manage end-to-end Accounting and Taxation functions, including:
• Accounting & Bookkeeping: Perform monthly accounting tasks and review books of accounts for accuracy and completeness.
• Auditing: Independently handle Statutory Audits, Tax Audits, and GST Audits, including preparation of annual returns (GSTR 9 & 9C).
• Financial Reporting: Prepare and review Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Account, and Cash Flow Statements.
• Tax Computations: Draft and review accurate Income Tax Computations.
• Regulatory Compliance: Draft and file timely responses to notices from government departments.
• Tax Filing: Manage GST, TDS, Professional Tax, and Income Tax return filings.
• Payroll: Oversee and finalize monthly payroll processing for clients.
• Reconciliations: Conduct reconciliations for GST and TDS.
• Accounting Standards: Apply strong knowledge of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Corporate Taxation.
• Transfer Pricing Audit & Documentation

Qualifications & Skills:
• CA Firm Experience: 3-6 years (Mandatory).
• CA/CMA dropouts can apply.
• B.Com/BBA/M.Com/MBA qualified can apply with relevant experience.
• Education/Expertise: Strong foundation in Accounting, Auditing, Taxation, and Compliance.
• Technical Skills: Proficiency in Tally, Advanced Excel, and accounting software.
• Knowledge: Strong understanding of taxation laws, GST, TDS, PT, Ind AS, and corporate taxation.
• Soft Skills: Analytical mindset, detail-oriented, strong communication, and organizational ability.
• Preference: Local candidates; in-person interviews preferred.
• Fluent in English with good communication skills
• Punctual, professional, and responsible

Ways to Stand Out:
• Display genuine interest in accounting, taxation, and compliance.
• Be proactive and take ownership of assignments.
• Show strong client handling and deadline management skills.
• Maintain professionalism, discipline, and team spirit.
• Demonstrate eagerness to learn and adapt to complex assignments.
• Come prepared for technical and practical interview questions

Next Step:

If you are an experienced accountant looking to accelerate your career with real-world exposure, diverse assignments, and professional mentorship, we would love to hear from you. Please share your resume on hr@registrationarena.com

ABOUT CENCORA & ABFINCO

Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen) is a Fortune 10 global pharmaceutical distribution and solutions company operating in more than 65 countries. ABFinco is Cencora’s international in-house bank, providing central cash pooling, foreign exchange and intercompany funding services to international businesses including Alliance Healthcare, World Courier and PharmaLex. ABFinco manages exposures in more than 10 active currencies.

ROLE PURPOSE

The Senior Treasury Accountant will deliver accurate, timely and well-controlled accounting for ABFinco’s foreign exchange, intercompany lending and cash activities. The role owns treasury accounting from transaction capture in Kyriba through posting and reconciliation in SAP, leads the monthly close, and provides quality review and technical support to Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts. Reporting to the Treasury Accounting Lead, the role will also strengthen controls, reporting and processes as the in-house treasury accounting function develops.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Treasury Accounting and Close

· Own accounting for FX, hedging, cash and intercompany treasury transactions in Kyriba and SAP.

· Review treasury entries, valuations and interest accruals.

· Lead the monthly close and deliver accurate management accounts and treasury reporting between workday 1 and workday 3.

· Reconcile Kyriba to SAP, resolve differences and maintain complete supporting documentation.

· Support hedge-accounting calculations, statutory reporting, Group consolidation and internal and external audits.

Intercompany Loans and Cash

· Oversee accounting and reconciliation for intercompany loans, cash pools and Group funding balances across 102 entities.

· Review loan interest, reference rates and margins against agreements and transfer-pricing requirements.

· Prepare and review loan, cash and bank reconciliation reports.

Controls and Systems

· Operate treasury-accounting controls, maintain audit evidence and support control testing.

· Maintain treasury-system master data and support Kyriba-to-SAP interfaces, reporting and process improvements.

· Support regulatory reporting and ensure transactions comply with internal policies and segregation-of-duties requirements.

Team and Stakeholder Support

· Act as the subject matter expert and escalation point for Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts.

· Work with Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Legal, IT, banking partners and international finance teams to resolve issues and support change.

PROFILE & SKILLS

Essential

· Chartered Accountant, Cost and Management Accountant, ACCA or equivalent finance qualification, with 4–7 years of relevant treasury accounting experience.

· Practical experience of month-end close, reconciliations, FX accounting and intercompany accounting.

· Hands-on experience with an ERP or treasury management system; SAP or Kyriba exposure is preferred.

Strong analytical, reconciliation and control skills, with attention to detail in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.

· Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills across Treasury, Finance, Tax, Legal and IT.

· Ability to review work, coach colleagues and manage priorities in a Shared Service Centre environment.

Preferred

· Experience in a multinational treasury, in-house bank or treasury shared-services environment.

· Knowledge of cash pooling, intercompany funding and hedge accounting under IFRS 9 or ASC 815.

· Exposure to Kyriba, SAP, Bloomberg, or trade-confirmation platforms.

· Treasury qualification or relevant professional development is desirable.
